Farmers of Malligere who lost their crop in the unseasonal rains have not received the insurance settlement for three days now. The survey was done, photos taken, and then silence. Loan recovery notices have started coming. Many of us voted with a lot of hope last time. Please ehlp us.

subject: Long pending issue
body: Namaste, The drainage line has clearly mixed inot the drinking water pipeline near ward 11. Two children are on drips at teh taluk hospital. People are still filling this water unaware. We are suffering a lot.

subject: Kindly look into this
body: Sir/Madam, An illegal liquor outlet operates openly near the school in the bus stand circle. Drunk men sit along the road children take. Written complaints have changed nothing. This has nothing to do with the school, the children are managing. The whole colony is waiting.

subject: Widow pension rejected wrongly
body: Namaste, Our names were on the list at the taluk office last year, but this month the dealer says our numbers on longer show in his machine. Ten families are affected in Gandhi colony.

subject: No drinking water in the old market area since the rains started
body: Namaskar, What arrives in our pipes for one hour every fourth day is barely enough. We request the department to revise the supply schedule for our layout. The new apartment construction next to the weavers’ colony has sunk multiple borewells and pressure in our street taps has dropped. Please inspect and regulate. The previous shikayat nmuber I was given never got a response. Kripya dhyan dijiye, bahut urgent hai.

subject: Street lights not working in the weavers’ colony
body: Sir namaskara, Our flour mill and the tailor shops in the weavers’ colony sit idle half the day because supply comes and goes without any schedule. Diesel for the generator is eating all profit. Our ration shop works fine, this is a different matter. This is tumba urgent.

subject: Housing scheme installment not released
body: Respected sir, The second installment of the housing scheme has not been released though the walls are complete and photos were uploaded. The half-built house is soaking in rain and the family is in a rented shed. The MLA promised action on this before the elections but nothing happened. Hoping for quick action.
